from t import *
import ref, json, wire as W, hashlib

def check(name, tr, manual=None):
    got = run([tr])['traces'][0]
    exp = ref.audit(tr)
    ok = json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(exp, sort_keys=True)
    bad = [] if ok else ['REF-MISMATCH']
    if manual:
        for k, v in manual.items():
            gv = got
            for part in k.split('.'):
                gv = gv[int(part)] if isinstance(gv, list) else gv[part]
            if gv != v: bad.append(f"{k}={gv!r} want {v!r}")
    print(f"== {name}: {'OK' if not bad else 'PROBLEM ' + '; '.join(bad)}")
    return got

# verify peer direction for ncid
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']),
           datagram(envelope('A', 0, bytes([0x18])+W.v(1)+W.v(1)+bytes([1])+b'\xdd'+b'\x11'*16, width=1), auth=[0]),
           datagram(envelope('A', 1, b'\x01', width=1), auth=[0])])
check("ncid-peer-direction", tr, {'packets.1.status':'OK', 'retire_prior_to':1,
                                  'peer_cids':[{'sequence':1,'id':'dd','token':'11'*16}]})

# --- stream suite ---
# a) overlap mismatch -> PROTOCOL_VIOLATION at later frame offset
f1 = stream(0, 0, b'abc', fin=False)
f2 = stream(0, 1, b'X', fin=False)   # overlap differs at offset 1
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, f1+f2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("overlap-mismatch", tr, {'packets.0.status':'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION', 'closed.offset': len(f1), 'streams':[]})

# b) equal overlap OK
f2 = stream(0, 1, b'b', fin=False)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, f1+f2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("overlap-equal", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'streams.0.ranges':[[0,3]], 'streams.0.unique':3, 'streams.0.prefix':3})

# c) final-size errors
fin1 = stream(0, 0, b'abc', fin=True)      # final 3
bad2 = stream(0, 0, b'abcd', fin=False)    # end 4 > final 3 -> FINAL_SIZE_ERROR
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, fin1+bad2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("final-size", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FINAL_SIZE_ERROR', 'closed.offset': len(fin1)})

# d) FIN end < high -> FINAL_SIZE_ERROR
f1 = stream(0, 5, b'abc', fin=False)       # high 8
f2 = stream(0, 0, b'a', fin=True)          # end 1 < high 8 -> FINAL_SIZE_ERROR
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, f1+f2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("fin-below-high", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FINAL_SIZE_ERROR'})

# e) flow control: stream limit
f1 = stream(0, 0, b'abcde', fin=False)     # high 5 > limits.stream=3
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, f1, width=1), auth=[0])], stream_credit=3)
check("flow-stream", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR'})

# f) flow control: connection limit with holes
f1 = stream(0, 0, b'ab', fin=False)        # high 2
f2 = stream(4, 0, b'cde', fin=False)       # high 3 -> used 5 > conn 4
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, f1+f2, width=1), auth=[0])], connection=4)
check("flow-conn", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR', 'used':2})

# g) reset keeps bytes; later stream discards without overlap check
f1 = stream(0, 0, b'abc', fin=False)
rst = bytes([0x04]) + W.v(0) + W.v(7) + W.v(3)    # reset err 7 final 3
f2 = stream(0, 1, b'ZZ', fin=False)               # overlap mismatch would PV; discarded after reset
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, f1+rst+f2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("reset-discard", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'streams.0.reset':7, 'streams.0.final':3,
                            'streams.0.ranges':[[0,3]], 'streams.0.high':3, 'used':3})

# h) reset below high -> FINAL_SIZE_ERROR ; reset differing final -> FINAL_SIZE_ERROR
rst2 = bytes([0x04]) + W.v(0) + W.v(7) + W.v(2)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, f1+rst2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("reset-below-high", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FINAL_SIZE_ERROR'})
rst3 = bytes([0x04]) + W.v(0) + W.v(7) + W.v(4)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, f1+rst3, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("reset-flow", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK'})  # final 4 >= high 3, no known final

# i) first reset/stop code retained
rst1 = bytes([0x04]) + W.v(0) + W.v(7) + W.v(3)
rst2b = bytes([0x04]) + W.v(0) + W.v(9) + W.v(3)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, rst1+rst2b, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("reset-code-retain", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'streams.0.reset':7})

# j) stop + max_stream_data on cat 2 -> STREAM_STATE_ERROR
stop = bytes([0x05]) + W.v(2) + W.v(5)   # id 2 = client-uni -> send ref -> STREAM_STATE_ERROR
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, stop, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("stop-cat2", tr, {'packets.0.status':'STREAM_STATE_ERROR'})

# k) STREAM on server-uni -> STREAM_STATE_ERROR; on server-bidi unopened -> STREAM_STATE_ERROR
s3 = stream(7, 0, b'a', fin=False)   # id 7 -> cat 3, idx 1
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, s3, width=1), auth=[0])], local_uni=2)
check("stream-cat3", tr, {'packets.0.status':'STREAM_STATE_ERROR'})
s1 = stream(5, 0, b'a', fin=False)   # id 5 -> cat 1, idx 1, localBidi=1 -> unopened
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, s1, width=1), auth=[0])], local_bidi=1)
check("stream-cat1-unopened", tr, {'packets.0.status':'STREAM_STATE_ERROR'})
# server-bidi opened ok
s1 = stream(1, 0, b'a', fin=False)   # id 1 -> cat 1 idx 0 < 1 ok
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, s1, width=1), auth=[0])], local_bidi=1)
check("stream-cat1-open", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'opened.bidi':0})

# l) opened counts with send refs and high ids
stop0 = bytes([0x05]) + W.v(4) + W.v(5)  # id 4 cat0 idx1 -> opens bidi 2
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, stop0, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("opened-sendref", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'opened.bidi':2, 'streams.0.id':4, 'streams.0.stop':5})
EOF
